newsitem.title: FRANCE: Sogeparc buys Gle des Eaux unit.
newsitem.headline: Sogeparc buys Gle des Eaux unit.

text.p: French car parking company Sogeparc has bought up all the capital of Compagnie Generale de Stationnement (CGS), a subsidiary of utilities and water company Cie Generale des Eaux, Generale des Eaux said on Wednesday.
Generale des Eaux will receive Sogeparc shares in a reserved rights issue, which will give it 19.9 percent in Sogeparc. Generale des Eaux will also get 121 million francs cash.
Sogeparc will have annual turnover of one billion francs after the deal, which will give it 150,000 spaces in covered car parks, and 160,000 in the open.
Generale des Eaux is selling off assets to repay debt.
